open_items: Validate native rendering and real EEG source labels on target hardware.
results: 236 core tests passed via project.cmd test (18.768 s).
144 GUI tests run via project.cmd test --gui: 141 passed, 3 native checks skipped (156.059 s).
New tests cover spectral power and units, IAF/source selection, persistence, timestamp gaps, electrode mapping, pause/history and stale source results. All 24 panel arrangements covered.
Offscreen preview with explicitly loaded Segoe UI: 1450x940 four-panel layout has no scrolling; 1024x700 stacks panels with vertical scrolling.
No dependency changes. Work remains uncommitted and local on codex/portable-environment; desktop main checkout was not modified.
summary: Implemented fourth RAW EEG topography panel, canonical band power and calibrated IAF Alpha, configurable window/overlap and unfiltered voltage persistence; validated locally.
limitations: Initial repository inspection preceded the first recorded timestamp.
Sensor positions are schematic 10-20/10-10; no digitized montage import.
Native OpenGL/device validation was not performed; three platform-specific tests were skipped.
Offscreen preview initially lacked system fonts; loading Segoe UI explicitly resolved preview glyphs and size hints.
